name: Spend weeks in ascetic contemplation of the incommunicable words within you

system.description: When you **_spend weeks in ascetic contemplation of the incommunicable words within you_**, roll +WIS: **on a 10+**, you gain insight into the power within you—mark 1 below; **on a 7-9**, gain advantage on your next attempt to contemplate the words.

success.value: you gain insight into the power within you—mark 1 below

partial.value: gain advantage on your next attempt to contemplate the words.
